text:
sam: quick heads-up — onboarding orion-rt-7B (hf -> runtime) on dedicated-int4. when we enable the per-head rotary adapter we see duplicated lines at the end of generations on long prompts.

leila: can you drop a tiny repro and what you tried so far?

sam: repro (trimmed):
```
prompt: "Draft a brief agenda for March 2026 team sync."
float32 + adapter -> ok: "Agenda: 1) OKRs
2) Roadmap"
int4 + adapter -> bad: "Agenda: 1) OKRs
2) Roadmap
2) Roadmap"  <-- repeats last bullet
```

diego: interesting. can you run `compare-rota --dump-basis --heads 0:3` between the HF weights and our converted blob and paste the head bases?

sam: pasted small diff in gists. quick summary: head0 basis L2 diff = 2.1e-4, head1 = 4e-7, head2 = 3e-6.

leila: head0 is definitely out of tolerance. our loader historically did a head-group reorder for some older exports (even/odd swap). could the converter have applied a different ordering?

sam: i toggled the loader's legacy head-swap off and reloaded the int4 artifact -> problem disappears, outputs match float32 baseline on a 200-prompt smoke run.

diego: that nails a head-order mismatch interacting with quantization + per-head scaling in the adapter. quant rounding amplified a small permutation error into visible decode artifacts.

qa-bot: regression job queued: id=ci-6498765432-01, targets=[dedicated-int4], samples=1000, metrics=[repeat_rate,ppl,latency_p50]. link: https://ci.redwood/tests/ci-6498765432-01 

leila: proposed action items: 1) open bug + PR to remove legacy head-swap (or gate it behind explicit conversions), 2) add unit test comparing elementwise head-basis hf_vs_runtime (tolerance=1e-6), 3) add optional runtime sanity check during model load to warn if L2 > 1e-6, 4) run int8 path (might be less sensitive).

diego: i'll take the loader PR and run microbenchmarks to ensure no perf regressions from the extra check.

sam: i'll file the issue with the tiny reproducer and attach the CI run. tagging @leila @diego for review. :thumbsup:

leila: also adding onboarding checklist item: "verify head-order + per-head rotary basis invariants post-conversion and after quantization" :memo:

sam: thanks — will update when PR lands.
